notes.androidpublisher: Google Play publisher API for app listings and releases; the brief groups Play partner and publisher APIs under business.
notes.playintegrity: App integrity verification used by Android developers, so it is developer tooling rather than business.
notes.chromewebstore: Publishing and management API for Chrome extensions, which is developer tooling.
notes.libraryagent: A sample or example API with no consumer product behind it, so it is grouped as developer tooling.
notes.addressvalidation: A Google Maps Platform product, so it sits with the other Maps and location APIs.
notes.civicinfo: Address-based location lookups (polling places, representatives), so it is grouped with the location APIs rather than search.
notes.fitness: Consumer fitness data that app developers read; grouped with developer data APIs, not business.
notes.health: Google Health API for health and fitness metrics; grouped with developer data APIs like fitness.
notes.homegraph: Smart-home device cloud for developers, grouped with the Nest device API under developer.
notes.smartdevicemanagement: Nest device access for enterprise partners, a developer-facing device API.
notes.jobs: Cloud Talent Solution is ML-based job matching in Cloud AI, despite its commerce-like name.
notes.recommendationengine: Recommendations AI is an ML product in Cloud AI, unlike recommender below.
notes.recommender: Resource recommendations for IAM and cost in Cloud, not an AI product.
notes.retail: AI Commerce Search is an AI product, but the brief places retail under business as search-adjacent commerce.
notes.checks: The description says privacy and compliance, but the product is an AI-safety classifier, so it sits with AI.
notes.agentregistry: Catalog and governance of MCP servers and AI agents on Agent Platform, so it sits with AI.
notes.agentidentity: Identity and credentials for AI agents, handled as IAM and therefore Cloud.
notes.agentidentitycredentials: Credential issuance for agent identities, handled as IAM and therefore Cloud.
notes.cloudidentity: Identity management for Workspace domains and groups, listed under workspace per the brief despite the Cloud name.
notes.cloudchannel: Resale platform covering Google Cloud and Workspace; placed in Cloud as a partner billing and procurement API.
notes.verifiedaccess: Chrome Enterprise device verification for enterprise networks, grouped with Chrome management under workspace.
notes.dataportability: Lets users consent to move their Google data to an app, grouped with People and Tasks under workspace.
notes.area120tables: A no-code table product from Google's Area 120, grouped with Workspace productivity apps.
notes.admin: Admin SDK covers the Directory and Reports APIs for Workspace administrators, so it sits in workspace.
notes.paymentsresellersubscription: Payments reseller API for selling Google subscriptions, grouped with business commerce.
notes.webcontentpublisher: Publisher-facing news and web content API, grouped with the reader revenue APIs under business.
notes.readerrevenuesubscriptionlinking: Publisher subscription linking for news readers, a publisher business API.
notes.travelimpactmodel: Travel carbon estimates for travel companies, grouped with business data APIs.
notes.walletobjects: Google Wallet passes issued by businesses, a consumer-business API.
notes.apim: Shadow API discovery in Apigee, which is Cloud API management.
notes.apihub: API inventory inside Apigee, which is Cloud API management.
notes.ftp: Managed SFTP that moves data into Cloud Storage, so it is Cloud data transfer.
notes.sasportal: Spectrum Access System for CBRS radio spectrum, a Cloud infrastructure service.
notes.prod_tt_sasportal: Test-track variant of the SAS Portal API, grouped with sasportal.
notes.hypercomputecluster: Deploys and manages AI and HPC clusters as infrastructure, so it is Cloud rather than AI.
notes.ces: Conversational agents for customer engagement, a Contact Center AI product.
notes.testing: Firebase Test Lab device testing for app developers, so it is developer tooling.
notes.toolresults: Publishes and reads results from developer test tools (Test Lab), grouped with testing.
notes.devicerun: Scheduling and execution of automated device sessions for developer testing.
notes.versionhistory: Chrome release history for web developers, grouped with developer tooling.
notes.contentwarehouse: Document AI Warehouse, part of Document AI.
notes.css: Comparison Shopping Service product-feed management, a merchant commerce API.
notes.localservices: Local Services Ads management, an ads product under business.
notes.datamanager: Ingestion of first-party data into Google ad products, grouped with ads APIs.
notes.agenciesandbrands: Authorized Buyers API for agencies and brands to manage ad deals, grouped with ad buying.
notes.curationpartners: Authorized Buyers API for curators to manage ad segments, grouped with ad buying.
notes.manufacturers: Manufacturer Center product data for Merchant-style commerce, under business.
notes.recaptchaenterprise: Bot and fraud protection for web apps, placed in Cloud security as the brief requires.
notes.webrisk: URL threat lists for Cloud security customers, placed in Cloud while Safe Browsing stays in search.
notes.safebrowsing: Browser-facing threat lists kept in search per the brief, separate from Web Risk in Cloud.
notes.cloudsearch: Search over Workspace and indexed enterprise data, placed in workspace per the brief.
notes.gamesConfiguration: Play Games publishing API, grouped with the games* family under developer.
notes.gamesManagement: Play Games management API, grouped with the games* family under developer.
